newsitem.title: UK: Mersey Docks drops Eurolink ferry service.
newsitem.headline: Mersey Docks drops Eurolink ferry service.

text.p: The Mersey Docks and Harbour Company said on Thursday it had decided to terminate its Eurolink passenger and freight ferry service from Sheerness in Kent, England to Vlissingen, Belgium, from December 1.

Mersey said it had entered a pooling agreement with Jacobs Holdings Plc, which has since January been the operator of the rival Dart Line from Dartford to Vlissingen in partnership with Belgian state shipping line RMT
The pooling deal will cover the four vessels currently employed on the two routes by both shipping firm Jacobs and ports operator Mersey Docks.
"Two of the four vessels will be offered for charter to third party users until the end of the charters on the two Eurolink vessels", the firms said in parallel statements.
